subject: general
question: Find the area of an equilateral triangle whose sides are 16 cm each.
solution:
**Given:**

Side of the equilateral triangle = 16 cm

**Concept:**

The area of an equilateral triangle can be found using the formula:

**Formula Used:**

Area = (√3 / 4) × side²

**Calculation:**

Area = (√3 / 4) × 16²

⇒ Area = (√3 / 4) × 256

⇒ Area = 64√3 cm²

**∴ The area of the equilateral triangle is 64√3 cm².**
